children: Realty firm Suraj Estate Developers Ltd on Saturday reported a 30 per cent decline in consolidated net profit to  ₹23.06 crore for the September quarter on higher expenses.
Its net profit stood at  ₹33.09 crore in the year-ago period.
Total income rose to 171.08 crore in the second quarter of this fiscal year from  ₹145.42 crore in the corresponding period of the preceding year, according to a regulatory filing.
The expenses rose to  ₹140.12 crore from  ₹101.33 crore during the period under review.
Mumbai-based Suraj Estate Developers Ltd is one of the leading realty firms in the country.

title: Suraj Estate Developers Q2 results: Profit down 30%
